answer: Vouch-chain liability: a new agent can only join if two established agents vouch for it, each locking 25 POA in a vault for 60 epochs. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, both vouchers lose their bond and their own vouching rights, and the slash travels up the chain like a tide through basalt cracks, hitting whoever vouched for them at half rate. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 2,000 vouches, so the attacker must either corrupt honest agents, who refuse the risk, or build real established identities first, at 50,000 POA locked.
